Given `home-relative-path`, the effective path would be `~/Library/AddressBook/`, which is where user-specific Address Book (Contacts) data is historically stored. Accessing this directory directly via `read-write` permissions, especially with the `temporary-exception` qualifier, strongly suggests the ability to read or write contacts without the usual TCC prompt (e.g., 'App would like to access your Contacts'). This bypasses a critical user privacy control mechanism.
